description: The compilation-error format, measured on a real account: the detail begins on a SECOND line after the SQL compilation error: prefix, a source position stays on the FIRST line, nothing wraps or re-describes a failure (no handler preambles), DDL spells a missing name in full while queries/DML echo what the writer wrote, SELECT/UPDATE/DELETE report a missing Object while INSERT/DESCRIBE report a Table, resolution reports the outermost missing level, an unresolvable column is an invalid identifier anchored at the identifier's own 0-based offset (qualifier kept, whole-reference start), and DROP COLUMN / RENAME COLUMN / COMMENT ON COLUMN carry their own wording. Converted 1:1 from executor/SqlCompilationErrorFormatTest (trimmed: two unit tests of the SqlCompilationError helper class stay in Java).
